name: WdFindWrap
description: Specifies wrap behavior if a selection or range is specified for a find operation and the search text isn't found in the selection or range.

constants.name: wdFindStop
constants.description: The find operation ends if the beginning or end of the search range is reached.

constants.name: wdFindContinue
constants.description: The find operation continues if the beginning or end of the search range is reached.

constants.name: wdFindAsk
constants.description: After searching the selection or range, Microsoft Word displays a message asking whether to search the remainder of the document.
